اقلعففنا (form IVq)
# اِقْلَعْفَفْنَا (iqlaʕfafnā) /iq.laʕ.faf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# اُقْلُعْفِفْنَا (uqluʕfifnā) /uq.luʕ.fif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
